findings.what: Leave check runs outside the booking transaction; a booking committing concurrently with recordLeave can remain 'booked' on a leave date
Offer nonce is spent before createAppointment; a non-SLOT_TAKEN/INVALID_SLOT failure leaves the entry 'offered' with an unusable link until the sweep expires it
Expiry sweep runs every 5 minutes, so offers pass to the next patient up to ~35 minutes after sending
AC-205 concurrency test runs on PGlite, which effectively serializes the calls; the guarantee rests on the unique index rather than on real parallelism in the test
Outstanding offers do not hold the freed slot; it stays publicly bookable and the offered patient may lose it (documented design choice)
